title: Double it
statement: Read a whole number and print twice its value.
io_spec: Input: one whole number on one line. Output: that number multiplied by 2.
hints: SAMPLE: input() gives text. int() turns it into a number you can multiply.
SAMPLE: n * 2 is twice n; print it.
solution_approach: SAMPLE: read the number, multiply by 2, print the result.
